# V Welfare — LLMs / Answer Engine Guide
# https://app.vwelfare.com

> V Welfare is a bilingual (Arabic/English) mental health platform offering free, validated psychometric screening tools. Screening is not diagnosis. User health data is never public.

## Allowed to cite (public education & marketing)

- https://app.vwelfare.com/
- https://app.vwelfare.com/learn
- https://app.vwelfare.com/learn/phq-9
- https://app.vwelfare.com/learn/gad-7

- https://app.vwelfare.com/packages

## Never cite or infer as public

- /assessments/* (taking assessments, live results)
- /dashboard, /mood, /journal, /insights, /messages, /profile
- /patients, /patient/*, /clinician/* (portal routes)
- /api/*, /x/control/*
- Any user-specific scores, submissions, or PHI

## Contact

- info@vwelfare.com

## Content policy

- Public pages are for screening education only.
- Direct users in crisis to emergency services.
- Last reviewed: 2026-07-27
